title: Generate quiz fails for biology, history and psychology lessons
scenario: Since Monday's release 2.3, Generate quiz returns 500 for many biology, history and psychology lessons while statistics and CS work. Error rate 2.3% to 17.8%. L2 sees 429s and wants a quota increase and more retries. You get logs for both days, the release diff, metrics and a replay of the model with recorded safety ratings.
task: Find the change and the mechanism that turns it into a 500
Explain the errors that existed before the release
Rule the quota theory in or out
Restore the right thresholds and return a graceful 422 for blocked content
acceptance: No lesson returns 500; ordinary lessons generate again
Blocked responses: 422 with status, source, category, message
All four categories configured, not LOW_AND_ABOVE, not NONE
Root cause and evidence in ANSWER.md
